rules: Press space to advance dialogue and text boxes.
To interact with NPCs or objects, try Enter or E if C does not trigger conversation.
To save: press Tab to open menu, navigate down to System, press Enter, select Save.
In confirmation prompts like Return to Title, use Enter to confirm, not mouse clicks.

To save your game in Persona 3 Reload on PC, press the [Esc] key to open the main menu during free-roam or dungeon exploration. Then, use your mouse or navigation keys to select the "System" option, and choose "Save" to record your progress.
